purpose: Define point-in-time meme-token traffic measurements without embedding an unvalidated trading formula.

features.claim: Determine curve, completion, migration and AMM state from pinned program and account state.
features.limits: Never infer phase from market capitalization or a provider badge.

features.claim: Sum executed buy and sell notional available by the cutoff for each event-time window.
features.limits: Raw volume is vulnerable to wash flow and is not demand by itself.

features.claim: Measure executed buy notional minus sell notional by window.
features.limits: Direction labels require venue-aware parsing and self-flow controls.

features.claim: Measure buy notional divided by total executed notional by window.
features.limits: A high value can reflect coordinated buying and cannot authorize a trade.

features.claim: Compare buy and sell transaction counts by window.
features.limits: Transactions are not independent people; one actor can split orders.

features.claim: Track the median executed trade size alongside dispersion and upper quantiles.
features.limits: Trade-size patterns are venue and regime dependent and easy to imitate.

features.claim: Count distinct signer or economic wallet addresses trading in each window.
features.limits: Raw wallets are Sybil-vulnerable and must not be called independent actors.

features.claim: Collapse only evidence-linked wallets and count distinct inferred entities.
features.limits: Entity resolution is probabilistic; shared services and exchange funding create false links.

features.claim: Compare entity-adjusted makers with raw unique makers.
features.limits: Depends on the coverage and calibration of the entity graph.

features.claim: Count wallets whose open-market balance changes from zero to positive in the window.
features.limits: Transfers, token-account churn and bundle distribution are not acquisitions.

features.claim: Measure point-in-time holder-count change over non-overlapping windows.
features.limits: Holder count is Sybil-vulnerable and snapshots reconstructed from future state are forbidden.

features.claim: Measure the current top-ten beneficial balance share after deterministic system-account exclusions.
features.limits: Do not exclude a holder solely because a provider labels it as an exchange.

features.claim: Recompute concentration after grouping typed, confidence-bearing entity links.
features.limits: The result is an inference and requires raw concentration beside it.

features.claim: Track creator and evidence-linked creator-cluster holdings and disposals.
features.limits: A zero direct creator balance does not prove no beneficial exposure.

features.claim: Measure current supply controlled by confidence-linked early-buyer clusters.
features.limits: Timing alone cannot establish common ownership.

features.claim: Measure supply acquired by parsed open-market buyers in the launch slot.
features.limits: This is an early-buyer cohort, not proof of a Jito bundle, common owner or manipulation.

features.claim: Measure supply acquired by one to five included transactions in a landed Jito bundle that contains both launch and buy activity by the cutoff.
features.limits: A returned bundle ID or nearby tip does not prove landing; a landed bundle proves coordinated submission, not common beneficial ownership or malicious intent.

features.claim: Measure supply associated with early buyers connected by typed funding evidence.
features.limits: Funding edges are facts; common control remains an inference and shared services can create false links.

features.claim: Retain GMGN's bundler_rate under its exact raw field name, source and method version.
features.limits: GMGN documentation describes this field inconsistently; its denominator is treated as unspecified and cannot be compared with supply-held or trading-volume shares.

features.claim: Retain GMGN's bundler_trader_amount_rate as a provider-classified bundle-trading volume ratio under its exact source and method version.
features.limits: The provider classification method is opaque; this volume denominator cannot be compared with supply-held cohort measurements.

features.claim: Track retained supply separately for each explicitly named launch-cohort method.
features.limits: Transfers require graph tracing; never collapse same-slot, Jito, funding and provider-label cohorts into an unnamed bundle percentage.

features.claim: Label every value as pair, venue-token or token-all-venues and distinguish circulating market cap, fully diluted value and provider-unspecified capitalization.
features.limits: Ratios are not comparable when scope, quote mint, supply convention or aggregation differs.

features.claim: Measure executable pool reserves and normalized USD liquidity.
features.limits: Reported liquidity can include unusable or non-canonical pools.

features.claim: Compare verified executable liquidity with consistently defined market capitalization.
features.limits: Market-cap conventions and token supply definitions vary.

features.claim: Quote the intended buy notional against a fresh executable route.
features.limits: A quote is not a fill and expires quickly.

features.claim: Construct and simulate an exit for the intended position size before eligibility.
features.limits: Current sellability does not guarantee future exit liquidity.

features.claim: Estimate wallet skill from only trades closed before the decision cutoff with shrinkage and uncertainty.
features.limits: Leader PnL does not include the follower's later fill or execution costs.

features.claim: Measure price and liquidity movement between leader confirmation and follower executable entry.
features.limits: Historical average penalties do not replace a current quote.

features.claim: Count timestamped mentions linked to the exact mint, verified official account or disambiguated token identity.
features.limits: Ticker and name matches alone are ambiguous.

features.claim: Count distinct authors and separately estimate author entities and communities.
features.limits: Accounts can be botted, purchased or controlled by one operator.

features.claim: Compare non-overlapping event-time mention rates and retain the baseline.
features.limits: Attention may follow price and cannot independently authorize a trade.

features.claim: Estimate the share of attention attributable to likely automation or coordinated promotion.
features.limits: Bot classification is probabilistic and drifts.

features.claim: Test whether new independent buyers and holders follow attention rather than spike simultaneously.
features.limits: Correlation, shared causes and reverse causality make causal claims unsafe.

features.claim: Decode whether mint authority is permanently revoked at the decision cutoff.
features.limits: Curve stage never makes mint authority inapplicable; unknown remains unknown, and revocation alone does not prove safety.

features.claim: Decode whether freeze authority is permanently revoked at the decision cutoff.
features.limits: Curve stage never makes freeze authority inapplicable; unknown remains unknown, and revocation alone does not prove safety.

features.claim: Verify the canonical index-zero PumpSwap migration pool and its initial LP mint-and-burn event.
features.limits: A generic scanner burn badge or current LP supply is insufficient because later liquidity providers can mint and redeem LP tokens.

features.claim: Preserve creator, funder, deployer, profit-recipient and prior-launch relationships as typed evidence.
features.limits: Shared services and exchange funding do not prove identity.

features.claim: Combine self-flow, repeated counterparties, circular funding, synchronized trades and breadth inconsistencies.
features.limits: No single pattern or provider flag establishes wash trading.
